links.outcome: Delineation time with versus without AI assistance in intended deployment mode
links.effect: AI-assisted delineation reduced time by 10.1 min (95% CI 7.4-12), a 31% decrease compared with oncologist delineating from scratch.
links.quote: AI-based delineations resulted in a time reduction of 10.1 min (95% CI: [7.4, 12] minutes), corresponding to a 31% decrease in delineation time.

links.outcome: Prospective clinical use of AI on live data with oncologist correction
links.effect: AI outputs were shown to and corrected by oncologists in live care, not hidden; median mean surface distance between AI and clinical delineations was below 2.1 mm.
links.quote: When using AI support, the median of the mean surface distance between the AI and clinically used delineation for all OARs and targets was below 2.1 mm.

unlisted_practices: Training segmentation model on manually uncurated clinical data without manual recontouring
Within-patient paired design comparing AI-assisted and manual delineation time

screen.reason: This prospective paired trial evaluates a clinically implemented AI delineation tool used in actual brachytherapy workflows, measuring delineation time and contour changes when oncologists edit AI-generated contours versus delineating from scratch.

primary.practice: AI-assisted contouring with clinician review and correction
